sourceTitle: Essay on the Principles of Translation
description: "Essay on the Principles of Translation" by Lord Alexander Fraser Tytler Woodhouselee is a critical work on literary translation written in the late 18th century. This essay aims to discuss and elucidate the principles and rules governing the art of translation, addressing both the difficulties involved and the standards for achieving a faithful yet stylistically appropriate rendition of texts.
